add_plan.source:
Study(
    title="Signals, side by side",
    question="Which of these rank coins alike, which add something of their own, and is a mix better than the best one?",
)

Subjects(
    mom7=Output("str_keelmom7000000000000000000@1", output="momentum_7d"),
    mom30=Output("str_keelmom3000000000000000000@1", output="momentum_30d"),
    carry=Output("str_keelcarry00000000000000000@1", output="funding_carry"),
    low_vol=Output("str_keellowvol0000000000000000@1", output="low_volatility"),
    oi7=Output("str_oibuild0000000000000000000@1", output="oi_buildup_7d"),
    rev1=Output("str_keelrev1000000000000000000@1", output="reversal_1d"),
    surge=Output("str_keelsurge00000000000000000@1", output="volume_surge"),
    mix_equal=Derived(Mix(members=["low_vol", "mom30", "carry"], weighting="equal")),
    mix_skill=Derived(Mix(members=["low_vol", "mom30", "carry"], weighting="skill", horizon=1)),
    s10=Output("keel/momentum_28d@1", output="momentum_28d"),
    s11=Output("str_oiscreen000000000000000000@2", output="oi_chg7"),
)

Run(
    days=Days("2026-05-04", "2026-10-30"),
    coins=Coins(["BTC", "ETH", "HYPE", "ZEC", "SOL", "XRP", "DOGE", "SUI", "BNB", "ADA", "LINK", "AVAX", "TRX", "LTC", "BCH", "DOT", "NEAR", "APT", "ARB", "OP", "INJ", "TIA", "SEI", "WLD", "JUP", "kPEPE", "WIF", "kBONK", "TON", "ATOM", "FIL", "ETC", "UNI", "AAVE", "MKR", "LDO", "CRV", "ENA", "ONDO", "PENDLE", "RENDER", "FET", "TAO", "STX", "IMX", "GALA", "SAND", "ILV", "AXS", "APE", "DYDX", "GMX", "SNX", "COMP", "SUSHI", "UMA", "BLUR", "JTO", "PYTH", "W"], chosen=TopByVolume(60, days=30, on="2026-10-31", market="perp")),
    costs=NoCosts(),
    data=Data("snap_6c1f0e8a2b9d4f37"),
)

Steps(
    ranks=Ranks(),
    footing=SameFooting(),
    skill=RankIC(horizons=[1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 10, 14]),
    steady=ICOverTime(window_days=20),
    alike=Correlations(seed=20261019),
    pair=PairOverTime(pairs=[["mom7", "mom30"]], window_days=30),
    left=WhatsLeft(against=["mom7", "mom30", "carry", "low_vol", "oi7", "rev1", "surge"], horizon=1),
    mix=SignalMix(mixes=["mix_equal", "mix_skill"]),
)

Views(
    Page(default="How alike they are", switch=["How alike they are", "Ranking skill, 1 to 14 days ahead", "Which led, and when", "Side by side"]),
    Heatmap("How alike they are", of="alike", x=Axis("result"), y=Axis("result_b"), colour=Raw(Control("measure", "rank_correlation", options=["rank_correlation", "skill_correlation", "top_overlap"]))),
    Curve("Ranking skill, 1 to 14 days ahead", of="skill", x=Axis("horizon"), series=Axis("result"), y=Raw("ic"), band=[Raw("ic_lo"), Raw("ic_hi")]),
    River("Which led, and when", of="steady", plot=Rank(Raw("ic_rolling"))),
    Table("Side by side", of="footing", rows=Axis("result"), columns=Axis("metric")),
    Bars("What each adds beyond the others", of="left", x=Axis("result"), y=Raw("ic_left")),
    Lines("How they move together over time", of="pair", series=Axis("pair"), plot=Raw("correlation")),
    Curve("Your mix against its parts", of="mix", x=Axis("horizon"), series=Axis("result"), y=Raw("ic")),
)

plan.source:
Study(
    title="Momentum rotation v3",
    question="How does v3 do against costs, delay, luck and later data?",
)

Subjects(
    v3=Strategy("str_momrot00000000000000000000@3"),
)

Run(
    days=Days("2025-03-23", "2026-10-29"),
    split=Split("2026-04-17"),
    coins=Coins(["BTC", "ETH", "SOL", "HYPE", "XRP", "DOGE", "SUI", "BNB", "ADA", "LINK", "AVAX", "TRX", "LTC", "BCH", "DOT", "NEAR", "APT", "ARB", "OP", "INJ", "TIA", "SEI", "WLD", "JUP", "kPEPE", "WIF", "kBONK", "TON", "ATOM", "FIL", "ETC", "UNI", "AAVE", "MKR", "LDO", "CRV", "ENA", "ONDO", "PENDLE", "RENDER", "FET", "TAO", "STX", "IMX", "GALA", "SAND", "ILV", "AXS", "APE", "DYDX", "GMX", "SNX", "COMP", "SUSHI", "UMA", "BLUR", "JTO", "PYTH", "W", "STRK", "ZK", "ZRO", "EIGEN", "ETHFI", "REZ", "BOME", "MEW", "POPCAT", "TRUMP", "FARTCOIN", "AI16Z", "VIRTUAL", "KAITO", "BERA", "IP", "MOVE", "ME", "PNUT", "GOAT", "HBAR", "XLM", "ALGO", "KAS", "ORDI", "MINA", "ZEC", "DASH", "NEO", "ICP", "RUNE", "ENS", "ZEN", "CFX", "BLAST", "SAGA", "NOT", "MEME", "ALT", "DYM", "MANTA"], chosen=SubjectUniverse("v3")),
    costs=Costs(fee=0.00045, slippage=0.00045),
    data=Data("snap_6c1f0e8a2b9d4f37"),
)

Steps(
    base=Backtest(),
    costs=CostStress(multiples=[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6]),
    late=DelayStress(days=[1, 2, 3]),
    top=TopCoins(n=30),
    without=WithoutBestCoins(n=5),
    luck=RandomBooks(books=150, seed=20261019),
    deflated=DeflatedSharpe(trials=TrialSet(count=388, snapshot="ledger@2026-10-19"), seed=20261019),
    ahead=ResampledPaths(days=365, paths=1500, seed=20261019),
    by_coin=ReturnByCoin(),
    markets=MarketStates(regime=Output("keel/btc_trend@1", output="trend", role="regime"), seed=20261019),
    alike=CorrelationWithRunning(against=[Paper("dep_momrotv4", commit="str_momrot00000000000000000000@4")], seed=20261019),
)

Bars(
    Bar("luck.summary", "share_below", ">=", 0.75),
    Bar("base.split", "after_share", ">=", 0.3),
    Bar("costs", "sharpe", ">=", 0.3, at={"cost_multiple": 2}),
    Bar("late", "sharpe", ">=", 0.3, at={"days_late": 1}),
    Bar("top", "sharpe", ">=", 0.3),
    Bar("without", "sharpe", ">=", 0.3),
    Bar("deflated", "deflated_sharpe", ">=", 0.5),
)

Views(
    Page(default="Your checks", switch=["Your checks", "Growth of 1", "Before and after the split"]),
    Checks("Your checks", of="bars"),
    Lines("Growth of 1", of="base", plot=Raw("growth"), marks=[VLine(SplitDay())]),
    Lines("Before and after the split", of="base", plot=Rebased("growth", start=SplitDay())),
    Curve("Sharpe as costs rise", of="costs", x=Axis("cost_multiple"), y=Raw("sharpe"), marks=[HLine(0), HLine(Final("base.summary", measure="sharpe", at={"window": "whole"})), VLine(Final("costs.summary", measure="break_even_multiple"))]),
    Bars("Sharpe when trading late", of="late", x=Axis("days_late"), y=Raw("sharpe")),
    Bars("Sharpe on the top coins", of="top", x=Axis("variant"), y=Raw("sharpe")),
    Bars("Sharpe without the best coins", of="without", x=Axis("variant"), y=Raw("sharpe")),
    Distribution("150 random books", of="luck", x=Raw("sharpe"), marker=Final("luck.summary", measure="yours")),
    Fan("A year ahead, resampled", of="ahead", x=Axis("horizon"), y=Raw("growth")),
    Bars("Where the return came from", of="by_coin", x=Axis("coin"), y=Raw("share_of_pnl")),
    Bars("Up and down markets", of="markets", x=Axis("group"), y=Raw("ret_year"), error=[Raw("ret_year_lo"), Raw("ret_year_hi")]),
    Bars("How it moves with what you run", of="alike", x=Axis("result_b"), y=Raw("correlation")),
)
